subject.title: feat(gateway): watched sessions in presence with viewer facepiles

question: Should raw watched-session keys remain restricted to `operator.read` recipients, with pairing/node presence receiving no keys or only a deliberately redacted aggregate?
rationale: This changes what lower-scoped gateway clients can learn from presence, so the intended privacy contract needs an explicit owner decision even though the secure default is clear.

options.title: Preserve the read boundary
options.body: Restrict raw watched-session keys to read-authorized presence projections and use a separate redacted shape where lower-scoped presence is required.

options.title: Broaden presence visibility intentionally
options.body: Document and approve raw session-key visibility for pairing and node clients, accepting that presence reveals session identifiers outside session discovery.

recommendation.title: Preserve the read boundary
recommendation.body: Restrict raw watched-session keys to read-authorized presence projections and use a separate redacted shape where lower-scoped presence is required.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged identity-presence prerequisite and this viewer-presence follow-up place the shared-gateway presence contract in this feature's active ownership trail.
